channel.title: Real Estate Capital - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Real Estate Capital (recapitalnews.com)

item.title: Iran war looms large over MIPIM
item.description: The potential impact of the developing crisis was the key topic of discussion in Cannes.

item.title: Loans in focus: A €400m Danish refinancing, Nordic banks back developer JM, Oxford and Hines source financing for London scheme
item.description: Nordea provides €400m to refinance a portfolio of Danish assets for manager Rubik Properties; five Nordic banks club together to back residential developer JM; Oxford Properties and Hines source financing for their redevelopment of 10 Paternoster Square in London; the latest additions to the Real Estate Capital Europe lending database; and more in our round-up of European loan deals from the past week.

item.title: Beyond rivalry: How banks and alt lenders are swapping competition for co-operation
item.description: To grasp opportunities in a reset European lending market, lenders need to look beyond their traditional roles, argue Deutsche Pfandbriefbank’s Duncan Pearson and Charles Balch in this episode of The PERE Podcast.

item.title: Savills says Eastdil deal will expand its capabilities with little overlap
item.description: The $921m acquisition will give Savills greater exposure to the US market and accelerate its ambition to offer clients investment banking services.

item.title: Puma gains firepower via £500m KKR living sectors partnership
item.description: The capital will enable the UK lender to offer more competitively priced loans to residential borrowers.

item.title: Term Sheet: Central bankers hold steady, SCOR corrals commitments, UK REITs stock up
item.description: Central bankers hold rates steady as the industry continues to evaluate the impact of the Iran war; France’s SCOR Investment Partners raises capital for value-add lending; two UK REITs announce significant debt deals; survey finds back leverage strategies being rapidly adopted in Europe; and more in today's briefing, exclusively for our valued subscribers.

item.title: Bank of England’s move to hold rates steady sparks debt volatility
item.description: UK swap rates and eurozone rose ahead of the UK central bank’s announcement that it would hold rates at 3.75%.

item.title: Inside MIPIM: Real estate focal points overshadowed by Iran crisis
item.description: In this episode of The PERE Podcast, the editorial team provide their top takeaways from the global trade show MIPIM. They also reflect on how delegates see the Iran crisis impacting the outlook for real estate capital flows.

item.title: DOWNLOAD: The latest CRE lending data
item.description: Explore the latest deals with our CRE lending database, featuring the most important commercial property financing transactions across European debt markets

item.title: SCOR scoops newcomers to real estate debt in €260m fundraise
item.description: The manager says there is ‘momentum’ behind its fundraising activities as it targets a €500m final close.
